title: How Many Holes Does a Human Have?
summary: Vsauce asks how many holes a human has and uses topology to show the answer depends on what counts as a hole, with animations and expert input.
why: Pointed to as a fun, light introduction to topology and to answer the human-holes question.

quote.text: If you'd like a fun, light, video introduction to this topic, this Vsauce video is worth a watch
